risk_text: Revenue recognition involved judgment over contract terms, cutoff, and variable consideration.
procedure_text: We tested a sample of contracts and invoices, evaluated cutoff, confirmed selected balances, and recalculated variable consideration.
evidence_text: Contracts, invoices, confirmation responses, revenue schedules, and recalculation outputs were inspected.

risk_text: Goodwill impairment depended on forecast cash flows, discount rate assumptions, and sensitivity to long-term growth.
procedure_text: We evaluated management forecasts, involved a valuation specialist, tested discount assumptions, recalculated the model, and performed sensitivity analysis.
evidence_text: Management forecast model, board-approved budgets, specialist report, valuation schedules, and sensitivity calculations were obtained.

risk_text: Inventory valuation involved obsolescence risk and estimation uncertainty.
procedure_text: We observed inventory counts, tested a sample of inventory records, assessed obsolescence assumptions, and recalculated selected valuation adjustments.
evidence_text: Inventory count sheets, ledger data, ageing reports, sample documentation, and valuation calculations were examined.
